intro.title: Welcome to Study
intro.body: Let's take a quick tour — what each setting does and how to get the most out of your sessions.

hero.title: Today's practice
hero.body: Shows how many cards are left and how many minutes it'll take. Tap Start to begin your smart daily mix.

heroShortcuts.title: How you study
heroShortcuts.body: Normal: exercises that test you and plan your next reviews. Shadowing: cards play by themselves — hear each word and say it back, nothing is graded. Focus tunes the exercise mix of normal study.

deckList.title: Your decks
deckList.body: Every deck you're studying, with its health status and mastery. Use the tabs to filter by what needs attention.

deckCard.title: Start a single deck
deckCard.body: Tap Start on any deck to choose exactly what to study from it.

scopeOptions.title: What to study
scopeOptions.body: Pick a scope: everything due now, only new words, words you keep getting wrong, or a random shuffle.

scopeFocus.title: Focus
scopeFocus.body: Choose which kind of exercises to lean on — listening, production, recognition, or your own custom mix.

scopeForce.title: Cram mode
scopeForce.body: Turn this on to review a deck's cards even before they're officially due.

scopeStart.title: Start studying
scopeStart.body: Kicks off the session with everything you picked above.

settingsTabs.title: Settings
settingsTabs.body: All your Study preferences live here, across three tabs: Pace & Decks, Activities, and Preferences.

settingsDuration.title: Daily target
settingsDuration.body: How many minutes you want to study each day — this shapes how many cards your daily plan pulls in.

settingsDeckStrategy.title: Deck strategy
settingsDeckStrategy.body: Mix studies all decks together, Single deck studies one at a time, and Rotation picks whichever deck has been neglected longest.

settingsDeckWeights.title: Deck weights
settingsDeckWeights.body: Give a deck more or less priority in the daily mix — higher means more of its cards show up.

settingsFocusChips.title: Exercise mix
settingsFocusChips.body: Pick a Focus preset and watch the bar below show exactly how your session mix changes.

settingsActivityList.title: Fine-tune each exercise
settingsActivityList.body: Turn any exercise type on or off and adjust its weight — the share on the right shows its slice of the mix.

settingsSrs.title: Spaced-repetition algorithm
settingsSrs.body: Choose how review intervals are calculated — Leitner, SM-2, or FSRS (the default, and usually the smartest).

settingsAutoRead.title: Auto-read
settingsAutoRead.body: Have each card read aloud automatically, and pick a US or UK voice.

outro.title: That's it!
outro.body: You now know your way around Study. Reopen this tour anytime from the Guide button next to Settings.

scorecard.title: AI check

meaning.pass: It says what the card asked for.
meaning.fail: It doesn't say what the card asked for.

elision.fail: An elision is missing — a word that must contract was written out in full (for example me aider instead of m'aider).

register.formal: Formal register — right for a letter or a stranger.
register.informal: Informal register — perfect for a text to a friend.

natural.yes: Sounds natural — a native speaker would say it this way.
natural.no: Correct, but a native speaker would put it differently.

error.gender_agreement: Looks like a gender or number agreement slip.
error.verb_conjugation: Check the verb's form or tense.
error.wrong_word: One word doesn't fit the meaning.
error.avoir_expression: French says avoir here, not être: j'ai faim, quel âge avez-vous ?

scorecard.needsAi: No scorecard this time: set up your own AI in Settings and your sentences get one.
